## Overview Extend the ROCm `QkNormRopeKvCacheFusionPass` so the AITER fused QK-norm + MRoPE + KV-cache-write kernel also covers the gated Qwen3.5-family attention prologue (Qwen3.5 / Qwen3.8: `attn_output_gate`, GemmaRMSNorm, interleaved MRoPE), and fix two gaps in the existing MRoPE path (K was not returned for backends that read it from the argument; the shuffledKV layout flag was never forwarded). Requires the companion AITER kernel change (add `q_head_stride` arg); without it the gated pattern is not registered and nothing changes: https://github.com/ROCm/aiter/pull/6584 ## Claims - With `-cc.pass_config.fuse_qk_norm_rope_kvcache=True` (default `rope_kvcache_fusion_max_token_num=256`), each Qwen3.8 full-attention layer runs one fused kernel per decode step instead of q/k RMSNorm + MRoPE + `reshape_and_cache`; at 64 tokens: 19 µs → 8.96 µs per-layer, 848 kernels → 784 kernels per-step. - MRoPE models whose attention backend reads K from the argument (ROCM_AITER_FA prefill) now get the normed, rotated K (`k_out`) when the fusion covers prefill ranges; previously the raw K view was returned (GSM8K dropped to 0.55 at `max_token_num=8192` before this fix). ## Validation A/B on one MI355X in the `vllm/vllm-openai-rocm:nightly` image of 2026-10-05 (vLLM 92044241a0, aiter 0.1.24.post1 + the companion AITER kernel): - `--attention-backend ROCM_AITER_FA -cc.use_inductor_graph_partition=True` on both sides - ISL=1024, OSL=1024, random prompts - `num_requests=10*concurrency` | Concurrency | Total tok/s | Mean TPOT (ms) | Median ITL (ms) | Mean TTFT (ms) | |--|--|--|--|--| | 4 | 690.2 → 693.9 (+0.5%) | 11.39 → 11.32 (−0.6%) | 11.16 → 11.03 (−1.1%) | 216.3 → 222.0 (+2.7%) | | 16 | 2035.5 → 2123.5 (+4.3%) | 15.09 → 14.48 (−4.0%) | 14.27 → 14.08 (−1.3%) | 655.8 → 616.2 (−6.0%) | | 32 | 3389.4 → 3460.8 (+2.1%) | 18.00 → 17.61 (−2.2%) | 16.90 → 16.75 (−0.9%) | 921.1 → 920.4 (−0.1%) | | 64 | 5284.2 → 5292.2 (+0.2%) | 23.21 → 23.13 (−0.3%) | 20.89 → 20.72 (−0.8%) | 1046.2 → 1099.9 (+5.1%) | Before: After: GSM8K (lm_eval local-completions, 5-shot, n = 1319, greedy): Main 0.7324 / 0.7051, PR 0.7255 / 0.6990 (flexible / strict). Tests: `tests/compile/passes/test_rocm_aiter_qk_norm_rope_kvcache_fusion.py` gains the gated + Gemma pattern (Qwen3.8 geometry: 24/4 heads of 256, rotary 64, plain and shuffled KV layout), a case that observes K through a non-attention consumer, and an unaligned-rotary rejection case; the existing MRoPE cases run unchanged. Reproduce: ``` # Serve vllm serve Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B --attention-backend ROCM_AITER_FA --language-model-only --max-num-batched-tokens 8192 \ -cc.use_inductor_graph_partition=True -cc.pass_config.fuse_qk_norm_rope_kvcache=True # Bench vllm bench serve --model Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B --dataset-name random --random-input-len 1024 --random-output-len 1024 \ --random-range-ratio 0 --ignore-eos --num-prompts 640 --max-concurrency 64 --temperature 0.0 --top-p 1.0 ``` ## Details The pass already fused QK-norm + MRoPE + cache write for dense-Q MRoPE models through `QkNormMRopeKvCachePattern`. The Qwen3.5-family prologue differs in three ways: - **`q_head_stride`**: with `attn_output_gate` the projection has `2·q_size` Q columns and each head is packed `[q | gate]`; the model views `[T, H, 2D]` and `chunk(2)`s, so Q is a strided view. The kernel reads Q at a head stride (the AITER change) instead of needing a dense copy; the gate view stays in the graph for `attn_output · sigmoid(gate)`. The pattern mirrors the model's split (`_split_qkv`) and returns the gate as an output so its consumer stays attached. - **`gemma_norm`**: the q/k norms are `GemmaRMSNorm` (`(1 + w)` scaling, `weight.float() + 1.0` in the graph). The kernel already supported it; the pass now registers both norm forms (the config does not say which a model uses) and `_extra_check` rejects a plain-norm match whose weight is a wildcard-bound intermediate of another dtype. - **`k_out`**: parity with the RoPE op. The fused op writes K to the cache; ROCM_AITER_FA's prefill consumes K from the tensor argument, so the replacement must return the normed, rotated K rather than the raw view. The old `_extra_check` guard that restricted K's consumers assumed every attention op reads the cache and is removed. Also forwarded: `use_shuffle_layout` (was hard-coded `False`). `fx_eliminate_noop_reshapes` normalizes the traced pattern the way `NoOpEliminationPass` normalizes the model graph (reshape-of-reshape, shape-preserving reshape), without which the gated split's view/chunk/reshape chain never matches. The `ROCM_AITER_UNIFIED_ATTN` backend only gains the three keyword parameters on its existing hook override (necessary plumbing, exercised by the pass test, not benchmarked). Scope and tradeoffs: the fusion applies to compile ranges ≤ `rope_kvcache_fusion_max_token_num` (default 256), i.e. decode. At prefill sizes the one-wave-per-(token, head) HIP kernel is slower than the three kernels it replaces (174 µs vs 127–145 µs per layer at 8192 tokens), so the cap stays. With the flag on, unfused ranges run the `rotary_embedding` custom op (forced by this pass) instead of Inductor's fused RoPE (which explains the TTFT increases for some concurrencies); matching the native MRoPE decomposition instead is a follow-up ---
Pull Request Checklist - [x] I used vLLM's `/pr-checklist` skill. (Mandatory for agents, optional for humans). - [x] AI assistance was used during the creation of this PR. - [x] **Design Fit:** Minimizes impact on core components, reuses existing functionality, and justifies added complexity. - [x] **Testing and Validation:** Validates the change and ensures any added tests are meaningful and reliable, with CI coverage or documented CI resource constraints and validation performed outside CI. - [x] **Code Quality and Style:** Keeps code and comments clear and concise, and updates relevant documentation and examples. - [x] **Pull Request Contents:** Includes a brief summary and relevant links, supports claims with evidence, explains root causes and implementation trade-offs, and follows the contributing guide.

         return QKNormRoPEKVCacheTestModel.forward(self, qkv, positions)
 
 
+class QKNormMRoPEGatedGemmaTestModel(QKNormMRoPEKVCacheTestModel):
+    """Qwen3.5 prologue: [q | gate] heads, GemmaRMSNorm, MRoPE, sigmoid(gate) output."""
+
+    def __init__(self, **kwargs):
+        super().__init__(**kwargs)
+        self.qkv_width = 2 * self.q_size + 2 * self.kv_size
+        eps = self.q_norm.variance_epsilon
+        self.q_norm = GemmaRMSNorm(self.head_size, eps=eps)
+        self.k_norm = GemmaRMSNorm(self.head_size, eps=eps)
+        with torch.no_grad():
+            self.q_norm.weight.normal_(std=0.1)
+            self.k_norm.weight.normal_(std=0.1)
+
+    def forward(
+        self, qkv: torch.Tensor, positions: torch.Tensor
+    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+        qkv = qkv.clone()
+        q_gate, k, v = qkv.split([self.q_size * 2, self.kv_size, self.kv_size], dim=-1)
+        orig_shape = q_gate.shape[:-1]
+        q_gate = q_gate.view(*orig_shape, self.num_heads, -1)
+        q, gate = torch.chunk(q_gate, 2, dim=-1)
+        q = q.reshape(*orig_shape, -1)
+        gate = gate.reshape(*orig_shape, -1)
+
+        q = self.q_norm(q.view(-1, self.num_heads, self.head_size)).view(
+            -1, self.q_size
+        )
+        k = self.k_norm(k.view(-1, self.num_kv_heads, self.head_size)).view(
+            -1, self.kv_size
+        )
+        q, k = self.rotary_emb(positions, q, k)
+
+        q = q.view(-1, self.num_heads, self.head_size)
+        k = k.view(-1, self.num_kv_heads, self.head_size)
+        v = v.view(-1, self.num_kv_heads, self.head_size)
+        kv_cache_dummy_dep = torch.ops.vllm.unified_kv_cache_update(
+            k, v, _encode_layer_name(self.layer_name)
+        )
+        output = torch.empty(
+            q.shape[0],
+            self.num_heads * self.head_size,
+            device=q.device,
+            dtype=self.dtype,
+        )
+        torch.ops.vllm.unified_attention_with_output(
+            q,
+            k,
+            v,
+            output,
+            _encode_layer_name(self.layer_name),
+            kv_cache_dummy_dep=kv_cache_dummy_dep,
+        )
+        # The gate must stay live (as in the model) for the pattern to match.
+        return q, output * torch.sigmoid(gate), v, kv_cache_dummy_dep
+
